title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (Application for Designation)
① Individuals seeking to be designated as research institutions must submit an application form for designation to the Minister of State Affairs and the following documents to the Minister of State Affairs:
1. Business plan for each item in Article 24 of the Enforcement Decree
2. Certified copy of the company registration (for companies only)
3. General information on the applicant institution (including organizational structure, main business and personnel information)
4. Any other documents required for the designation review
② Research institutions whose designation period under Article 10, Paragraph 1 has expired may also submit an application for designation, and in this case, they must also submit the documents specified in Paragraph 1.
③ The application period for designation must be at least 30 days.
④ Applications for designation can be submitted electronically and by mail.
